outer_multicall_in_progress.meaning: an outer multicall batch operation is in progress
outer_multicall_in_progress.checkpoint: before the outer multicall loop executes its inner calls

inner_call_is_nested_multicall.meaning: one inner call of the outer multicall is a call to multicall itself executed via delegatecall
inner_call_is_nested_multicall.checkpoint: before the nested inner multicall executes

subsequent_call_requires_fee.meaning: a subsequent call in the outer multicall requires a fee with a nonzero required fee specified in the call parameters
subsequent_call_requires_fee.checkpoint: before the subsequent fee-requiring call executes

legitimate_batch_completes.meaning: the legitimate batch transaction that requires a fee completes successfully rather than failing
legitimate_batch_completes.checkpoint: after the outer multicall batch finishes executing

legitimate_batch_fails.meaning: the legitimate batch transaction that requires a fee fails
legitimate_batch_fails.checkpoint: after the outer multicall batch finishes executing

assumptions: The nested multicall and the subsequent fee-requiring call occur within the same outer multicall transaction.
The legitimate batch transaction is the one that follows the crafted nested multicall and requires a fee.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker must be authorized or whether anyone can call multicall; the crafted nested multicall scenario is treated as reachable without further authorization facts.
Report does not specify the exact fee amount or the msg.value/msgValue comparison operands beyond msg.value == msgValue.

limitations: The impact is potential: the plan formalizes only the report-supported conditional scenario in which a crafted nested multicall precedes a fee-requiring call in the same outer batch.
The failure is represented as a Boolean completion/failure outcome because the report gives no numeric fee or revert-code detail.
The _isMulticall flag reset mechanism is treated as the reported cause and is not encoded as a precondition.
